report_parsed.summary: Surveyed all 17 authorized services of the OTel Demo across the authorized 24 h frame (2026-09-28T11:25:29Z to 2026-09-29T11:25:29Z) using whole-frame metric evaluations and per-service trace searches. Whole-frame span-call increases cover 16 service_name values (no series for image-provider or kafka), and whole-frame STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exist only for cart, checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment (value 0), product-catalog and recommendation, with totals frontend 52.39, frontend-proxy 35.06, load-generator 19.40, product-catalog 15.71, checkout 7.52, cart 3.33, recommendation 2.10, payment 0. Operation-level breakdown ties most of those errors to a small set of hops (product-catalog GetProduct, checkout PlaceOrder, cart EmptyCart, frontend/proxy HTTP routes), and checkout is the only service with non-zero client gRPC error status codes (13 = 2.10, 9 = 3.30). Latency is derivable only for four services from registered rpc histograms (server: ad 20.94 ms mean / 53.20 ms p95, checkout 672.62 / 5243.06 ms, product-catalog 0.55 / 4.79 ms, otelcol-contrib 1.07 / 4.94 ms; client: ad and fraud-detection means near 600 s with p95 10000 ms over only 2.095 calls each, checkout 46.11 / 36.63 ms). Trace searches returned only the newest sampled traces of each service (roughly one to five minutes at the frame end) even though the query window was the full 24 h; all returned spans were non-error (no error_rows, tags only rpc.grpc.status_code=0, http 200/308, otel.status_code=OK or absent). The requested 15 s step over the whole frame was not delivered: that query covered only 2026-09-28T18:01:29Z to 18:35:14Z, in which checkout PlaceOrder server errors and checkout to product-catalog client errors were non-zero from 18:04:29Z to 18:18:14Z and checkout to cart EmptyCart client errors from 18:13:29Z to 18:29:14Z. No baseline period exists inside the authorized frame, so no latency or error trend is asserted. Findings are useful but partial: frame-wide error timing, latency for 13 services, and runtime evidence for image-provider and kafka remain unknown.
